predict.question: You spray a field of 100 pests. The ten resistant ones each survive 90% of the time; the ninety others survive 10%. What share of the pests do you expect to survive?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Selection can undermine pest-control assumptions by favoring resistant organisms.
modelBoundary: Rare resistance gives {A}%; the changed mix gives {B}%. Both survival rates stay fixed, but weight moves to the high-survival group.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? These are stipulated expected percentages, not pesticide measurements or a simulation of resistance evolving.
